- Repo: kira-space · Branch: feat/a · Worktree: /wt/kira-space/feat-a
Kira Space tools: task_info, declare_repos, request_branches. Your working directory may be a repo root: read it, change nothing there. Create branches and worktrees only with request_branches, one call for all; you name each, the user approves. Never git branch, git worktree or git checkout -b. Work in the returned worktrees.
When this stage is done, write your handover to its draft file in the task folder, then call submit.
